pages.description: A synthetic page whose text lives in a JSON data file, for the Indexive QA sweep.
pages.heading: Indexive data page one
pages.body:
This synthetic page keeps its text in a data file instead of a Markdown file, in a café style of "quoted" copy.

Nothing here is a real service, customer or offer. It exists so the publishing checks can run.

Why a data file

Many sites keep page copy in JSON, so this page does the same.

pages.description: A second synthetic page in the same JSON data file, which the sweep must never change.
pages.heading: Indexive data page two
pages.body:
This second synthetic page shares its data file with the first, and stays exactly as it is.

If its text ever changes, the sweep touched the wrong entry.
